correctness.rationale: The unique zero-gap parameterization is exhaustive for every binary fixed-weight source. Increasing an already length-two zero gap only inserts all-zero windows at read widths two and three, proving invariance of the five positive-grade counts under capping. Distributing remaining zero symbols across t capped-long gaps gives exactly binomial(n-m+t-1,t-1) sources; disjoint capped classes yield every complete inverse fiber. Every capped vector is available by n=3w+2 and the all-two cap signature contains 3w single-one three-windows, impossible at n=3w+1 which has only 3w-1 such windows. For weight three, all 65 capped patterns with at least one two are exhaustively partitioned into 29 signatures in the attached certificate, with n=11 realization, and all n=3..10 computed by bounded four-gap enumeration. The standalone verifier independently cross-checks complete fibers for 106 (n,w) instances through n=18 and the three-marker series through n=30; finite checks are not substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The motivating short-fragment composition paper explicitly presents limited-read code-capacity questions. The theorem gives complete and computable all-length inverse-list sizes for arbitrary fixed weight in the first higher short-read case r=3, identifies a sharp n=3w+2 plateau, and proves a full exact three-marker capacity sequence ending at 29. It demonstrates mathematically that growing sparse source length does not increase distinguishable mass profiles after a precise threshold, with consequences for zero-error codes and inverse ambiguity. This is a motivated infinite-parameter structural classification, not just isolated experiments or a small arbitrary lookup.
